newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK FINMIN SAYS IN TALKS WITH CBANK, NO RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK FINMIN SAYS IN TALKS WITH CBANK, NO RESULTS.

text.p: Slovak Finance Minister Sergej Kozlik on Tuesday said he and the central bank (NBS) were in "regular" talks on monetary policy, but added it would be "premature" to anticipate any results yet.
Asked if he saw room for an easing NBS tight monetary policy or whether his ministry had proposed a loosening, Kozlik told Reuters during a regular government meeting:
"We are holding regular talks with the NBS but any thoughts of easing monetary policy would be premature at this stage."
